description: Fires when the stone just played is the first stone in column 5 (second from the right); strongest early in the game (~11 at ply 4), weaker late (~2-5). Weakly also fires for a second column-5 stone on the same player's stone (mainly when the second player moved), and at ply 4 for the first stone in column 0. A column-5 stone on the other colour, or a third stone there, does not fire.
effect: Small and position-dependent: zeroing it at a strong firing (3,4,2,5) cuts the model's favoured column 3 from 0.98 to 0.77; elsewhere changes are under 10 points, generally sharpening whatever reply the model already prefers. No fixed column is promoted.
notes: Layer-0 unit, essentially a 'last token = column 5 into an empty column' detector. Scores: p1 0.823, p2 (first stone in col 5 only) 0.834 precision 1.0, p3 +same-colour 2-stack for second player 0.888, p4 +ply-4 first stone in col 0 0.896 (P 0.90 R 0.89, AUROC 0.944, sim share 0.80). Residual errors are late-game col-5 moves hovering at the 2.1 threshold. Synth 6,4,3,5 = 11.56 beats dev max.
